find: const lost = sameSlots ? next.stocks.find((s) => s.stock < (before.get(s.slot) as number)) : undefined;
replace: const lost = sameSlots ? next.stocks.find((s) => s.stock !== (before.get(s.slot) as number)) : undefined;
killedBy: live status announcements (issue #629) does not narrate a rematch, where every stock goes back UP
why: Announces on any CHANGE rather than on a decrease, so a rematch -- where every stock resets upward -- is narrated as a stock loss. The direction is the whole meaning of the announcement: `!==` and `<` agree on every real loss and disagree only on the setup, which is precisely where the sentence is false.
